strategies.name: fair_value_gap_trend_continuation_retest
strategies.entry_summary: Trade in the direction of the prevailing trend after a fair value gap that caused a break of structure forms. Mark the gap between the first candle's close and the third candle's open in the three-candle imbalance, preferably the FVG closest to an order block, then wait for price to retrace into the
strategies.exit_summary: Place the stop loss just beyond the fair value gap itself—below the FVG for buys and above the FVG for sells. Hold for continuation in the trend direction after the tap into the gap; no fixed target rule is specified beyond letting price continue.

variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: wait for price to retrace into the bullish FVG that caused the break of structure
variants.transcript_quote: price will most likely come back mitigate the imbalance and keep pushing to the upside

variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: wait for price to return to the bearish FVG that caused the break of structure
variants.transcript_quote: once that FVG is created, all you just need to do is patiently wait for you know price to get back into that FVG that caused the break of structure

result.enumeration_note: One runnable FVG trend-continuation skeleton is taught, with bullish and bearish directions as compatible directional variants sharing the same entry/stop logic; no separate opposing reversal strategy is taught.
